known_assets: Map 1 runtime wall/floor/stone source images remain the Wikimedia Commons materials recorded directly in visuals/spaces-lab/index.html.
Map 1 v15 derives atlas.archBacking at runtime from the existing wall material, then cuts an arch-shaped opening with the same geometry as the structural crown. No new external asset was added.
Map 2 uses procedural solid violet world-space materials rather than stretched image textures.
visuals/spaces-lab/assets/checker-grid.svg remains historical/optional and is not loaded by the current runtime.
rule: Reuse stable source materials when possible. Structural backing may be generated from existing textures, but lighting and visibility must remain world-space. Tall structures use 3D-distance lighting including vertical distance.
